key_decisions.decision: Retain silence beside praise, noting difficult relation; include separate title.
Preserve singular me to plural our and atonement verb.
Keep cosmic scope and righteous answer, not private assurance only.
Keep geographical horizons rejoicing rather than merely times of day.
Retain third-person God within address and doubled preparation.
Keep crown and tracks, not a generic prosperous year.
Keep land clothed and singing, not replace with human praise.
